2382.title: bb status exits 0 against a dead daemon and hangs with zero bytes against a stalled one
2382.rootCauseOneLine: The CLI injects raw fetch and bypasses SDK limits; status then hides connection failures and prints local context with exit code 0.
2382.proposedFix: Use the SDK limit for normal CLI requests. Reserve raw fetch for long plugin dispatch. Make status fail without a server response.
2382.caveats: The 3-second test proves the silent wait, but it does not measure the platform limit. The secondary invalid-data matrix remained unverified.

2548.title: bb plugin new discards npm's failure output, so a failed scaffold install gives no reason
2548.rootCauseOneLine: The npm install catch block ignores the rejected execFile error, so the CLI loses npm's captured stderr.

prReviews.topFinding: The eight-line global tail can let noisy stdout remove npm's stderr diagnosis.

2548.proposedFix: Narrow the caught error. Prefer a bounded stderr tail. Use stdout only as a fallback. Test failures that write both streams.
2548.caveats: The unit reproduction did not need a browser. The first test setup found a private native ABI mismatch. Both revised patches now apply cleanly.

2523.title: Copying a chat text selection pastes invisible trailing newlines
2523.rootCauseOneLine: Chromium adds block-boundary newlines to the native range, while bb trims only the menu payload and pastes unchanged clipboard text.

prReviews.topFinding: The fix removed all clipboard spill in live Chromium. One unrelated Linux AppImage smoke check failed with SIGTRAP.

2523.proposedFix: Add a shared copy handler. Clip only a whitespace boundary spill during native serialization, then restore the original selection.
2523.caveats: This fixture produced six clipboard newlines, while the issue recorded seven. Turbo test setup stopped with signal 139. Direct base tests passed 127 tests. The focused PR test passed 18 tests.
